Only 10 minutes before bed? What's worth it in WoW Forever:
1) Turn in finished quests: quick XP, sometimes a whole level.
2) Visit a trainer: new class spells, or a profession like First Aid (in Bloodhoof Village the First Aid trainer stands right in the inn).
